reason: Record provider-call intent durably before network I/O so a process kill after request transmission cannot be mistaken for a request that was never sent.

implementation_change.ordering: durably appended after an exclusive request claim and immediately before provider network I/O

implementation_change.accepted_response_behavior: unchanged; the first schema-valid accepted response remains terminal for each request
